arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse, re
fmt = '''
            letters: {:w}
            fixed-point: {:f}
        '''
text = '''
            letters: abcdef
            fixed-point: 0.00001
        '''
p = parse.Parser(fmt)
print('Expression:', repr(p._expression))
m = re.match(p._expression, text)
print('Regex match:', m)
if m:
    print('Groups:', m.groups())
" 2>/dev/null
